src.label: ŠVPS (Slovak State Veterinary and Food Administration) — notice on entry of companion animals from Ukraine (21 December 2022)

head: Pets from outside the EU must meet the standard EU conditions; Slovakia has no special exception.
lines: In December 2022 the ŠVPS cancelled all exceptional entry conditions for pets of refugees from Ukraine with immediate effect, after rabies was confirmed in a stray dog caught on the Slovak-Ukrainian border at Veľké Slemence.
Since then a pet from Ukraine or any other third country must meet the general EU conditions for non-commercial entry of companion animals into Slovakia.
The ŠVPS sends travellers to the European Commission website for the detailed conditions. The notice does not list the steps itself, so check the Commission page and ask the ŠVPS before you travel.
